title: Update Base Registration description in Fee Breakdown

requirements.summary: Update the Base Registration description in the Fee Breakdown section to show '₹149 × 1 member' on the first line and 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event' on the second line, matching existing font style, text color, and alignment
acceptanceCriteria: The Base Registration description shows '₹149 × 1 member' on the first line and 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event' on the second line.
The second line matches the font style, text color, and alignment of the existing description text.
Spacing between the two lines is visually consistent with surrounding content.
The Additional Event section is unchanged.
No layout or styling changes are made outside the description text.

file_operations.description: Locate the Fee Breakdown section where the Base Registration description currently displays '₹149 × 1 member'. Update this text to render as two lines: the first line showing '₹149 × 1 member' and the second line showing 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event'. Ensure the second line inherits the same text styling (font family, size, weight, color) and alignment as the first line. Maintain consistent vertical spacing between the lines. Do not modify the registration amount (₹149), fee calculation logic, Additional Event section, or any other layout or styling elements.
